summary: The XRD analysis in this paper demonstrates that CsPbBr3 nanocrystals synthesized with a combination of tetradecyl phosphonic acid (TDPA) and octadecyl phosphonic acid (ODPA) exhibit a pure orthorhombic perovskite phase (ICSD 98751) with no detectable secondary phases. The peak positions match those of bulk CsPbBr3, and the moderate peak width suggests nanocrystalline character. Only one XRD pattern is provided, limiting cross-sample comparison.
experimental_variables: Phosphonic acid ligand identity and ratio (TDPA-ODPA, MPA-ODPA, HPA-ODPA, TDPA only)

key_findings.finding: XRD pattern of CsPbBr3 NCs synthesized with TDPA-ODPA (3:1) matches the orthorhombic CsPbBr3 phase (ICSD 98751) with no secondary phases detected.
Peak positions in the XRD pattern (15.2, 21.6, 30.6, 34.3, 37.8, 43.7, 47.2, 51.1, 56.0, 62.2, 66.2 degrees) correspond to bulk CsPbBr3 reflections.

scientific_interpretation.claim: The CsPbBr3 nanocrystals synthesized with TDPA-ODPA (3:1) are phase-pure and adopt the orthorhombic perovskite structure, as evidenced by the absence of secondary phases in the XRD pattern.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: The XRD pattern shows only peaks assignable to orthorhombic CsPbBr3 (ICSD 98751), and the caption/text explicitly state no secondary phases are present.

citations.evidence: In (f) the bulk reflections of CsPbBr 3 (ICSD number 98751) are represented by means of black bars.
All the NC samples had an orthorhombic CsPbBr 3 perovskite structure (ICSD: 98751) and did not contain any secondary phases as evinced by our XRD analysis (Figure 1f and Figure S2 ).

scientific_interpretation.claim: The moderate peak width in the XRD pattern suggests the CsPbBr3 nanocrystals are of nanoscale size, consistent with TEM and DLS results.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: The analysis notes 'peak_width: moderate', which is typical for nanocrystalline materials, and the text/TEM/DLS confirm nanocrystal sizes.

citations.evidence: TEM and DLS analyses revealed that by changing the chain length of the PAs it was possible to tune the size of CsPbBr 3 NCs from ∼7 to ∼17 nm (Figure 1a-e ) with no presence of aggregates.

limitations.claim: Only one XRD pattern (TDPA-ODPA, 3:1) is shown in the main figures, preventing direct comparison of phase purity or crystallinity across different ligand combinations.

citations.evidence: In (f) the bulk reflections of CsPbBr 3 (ICSD number 98751) are represented by means of black bars.

limitations.claim: No quantitative peak width (FWHM) or lattice parameter data are provided, limiting the ability to estimate crystallite size or detect subtle structural changes.

The absence of XRD data for samples prepared with other PA combinations (e.g., MPA-ODPA, HPA-ODPA, TDPA only) means phase purity and structural trends with ligand identity cannot be established from the main figures.
